name: mock-pick
description: WireMock stand-in for an A2A 1.0 agent that answers with the model alias and the reasoning level a message names (model-pick/v1 and reasoning/v1, ADR 0086; local development only). It offers two neutral aliases and two levels, its defaults are alias-a and low, and it says in its answer which alias and level it was told.

extensions.description: Answers with the model alias a message names, when it offers it.
Answers at the reasoning level a message names, when it offers it.

skills.name: Work under a pick
skills.description: Does a piece of work with the model alias and reasoning level the message names, and says which.
